cases.code:
def search(cursor, name):
    cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'")
cases.description: Interpolating untrusted name into SQL permits SQL injection.
Passing user-controlled input to a shell command with shell=True enables command injection.
The changed transfer behavior has no tests for debit failure or credit failure and may leave balances inconsistent.

cases.code:
def search(cursor, name):
    cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = %s', (name,))
cases.description: Parameterized query keeps user input separate from SQL syntax; no defect is present.
